sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a mouse character. Draw this exact mouse as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the body: the grey-brown upright body with its cream tummy, without head, arms, legs or tail; its top, normally under the head, rounded.
2. the head: the grey head with its pink nose and whiskers, facing left as in image 1, with a completely blank face — no eyes, no mouth — keep the nose, the whiskers and the rosy cheeks; without ears; its bottom edge rounded.
3. one ear: a big round ear with its pink inside, with a rounded base.
4. one arm: a small arm with its pink paw, bent at the chest as in image 1, with a rounded shoulder.
5. one leg: a hind leg with its long pink foot, with a rounded hip.
6. the tail: the long thin pink tail, curling, with a rounded base.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a mouse character; image 2 shows the same mouse cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the mouse's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the mouse in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2.

Draw each piece on its own, spread out in tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. the mouse's left eye (on the right of image 1) as it is in image 1: a dark round eye with a white sparkle.
2. the same eye wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, with its white sparkle.
3. the same eye gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line with a few lashes.
4. the same eye closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc.
5. the same eye sad: looking down, its upper lid tilted up towards the middle.
6. the mouth as it is in image 1: a small happy smile.
7. the mouth wide open in a big happy laugh, the inside pink.
8. the mouth open in a small round 'o'.
9. the mouth in a small sad frown.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a mouse character; image 2 shows the same mouse's face pieces (eyes and mouths). Draw the mouse's eyebrows as separate pieces on one sheet, in the same drawing style, dark brown colour and line as the eyebrows in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the mouse in image 1, spread out in a tidy row with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. the eyebrow over the eye on the left of image 1, exactly as it is in image 1: a short, thin, dark brown arc curving up in the middle.
2. the eyebrow over the eye on the right of image 1, exactly as it is in image 1: a short, thin, dark brown arc curving up in the middle.
3. the first eyebrow sad: the same short thin arc, tilted so its inner end (the end towards the other eye, its right end) is raised and its outer end lower.
4. the second eyebrow sad: the same short thin arc, tilted so its inner end (the end towards the other eye, its left end) is raised and its outer end lower.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no eyes, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.

animations.description: the mouse sniffs the air with its whiskers twitching, rises up on tiptoes to look and listen, then drops down and washes its face with its paws.

pause.shows: the mouse up on tiptoes, ears wide, looking and listening

animations.description: the mouse scampers along to the left on its quick little feet, leaning forward with its paws tucked in and its tail curling behind, then stops and sits up.
the mouse rubs its face with both paws, round and round, then gives its ears a little shake and smiles, all clean.
the mouse twitches one big ear, then the other, listening to a little sound.
the mouse gives a little squeak, ears up and its mouth a small round 'o'.

pause.shows: the mouse squeaking, ears up, its mouth a small 'o'

animations.description: {the} crouches, jumps up high for joy and lands with a little squash.
{the} looks one way, then the other, then back.
{the} laughs and laughs, bouncing with giggles.
{the} does a happy little dance, swaying from side to side.
{the} talks, its mouth moving, its head bobbing a little.
{the} shivers and trembles, cold or scared.
{the} cries, head down, shoulders shaking with little sobs.
{the} gives a big yawn, closes its eyes and falls asleep, then wakes up, blinks and smiles.

the mouse grabs hold with both little paws and leans back to pull, heave-ho, straining with its eyes squeezed shut, then lets go and stands up with a happy puff.
